name: Terrain Source Watch
description: The monthly source check of the terrain refresh flow (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only; every hostcall an SDS $PIV invocation). For one body (config body: moon | mars) it probes every source file the terrain walk reads - the table terrain-ingest's body_plan uses, generated into src/watch_sources.hpp and held to it by tools/generate-sources.mjs --check - with a one-byte ranged GET (ETag, Last-Modified and the total size in one exchange; a HEAD fails on the Go node's http connector when it answers a Content-Length), lists the raw/<naif>/ mirror through storage/object-s3, and diffs the two. The diff is a $QRP projection page (body, naif, product, file, state, source_url, serves, source_etag, pinned_etag, source_last_modified, mirror_key, source_size, mirror_size, mirror_modified_ms, probe_error), stored beside the mirror as <report_prefix>/<naif>/<yyyy-mm-dd>.qrp through an object-s3 put task, and summarized in one FlowNotice. States: current, source-changed (the live ETag is not the one the walk is pinned to), source-newer (no pin; modified after the mirror was written), size-changed, not-mirrored, probe-failed. It never touches the network and holds only the clock: it builds requests for hostcap/http-request and tasks for storage/object-s3, and reads their answers. Config (plugin.getConfig): body, store, endpoint, bucket, region, report_prefix, timeout_ms, pins (off: compare size and Last-Modified only).

sequentialJustification.detail: Each method reads its frames and makes at most one synchronous clock hostcall, then emits requests, tasks or a report. No shared mutable state, no worker pool, no fan-out inside the guest. This guest can never spawn a thread, so it compiles the single-thread lane rather than claiming a wasi-threads contract it does not honour.

methods.description: One timer tick -> one ranged-GET HttpRequest per source file of the configured body (CONTEXT: the table index) on probes, and one object-s3 list task for raw/<naif>/ on list. An unconfigured check (no endpoint, an unknown body) emits one FlowNotice Missing and nothing else.

acceptedTypeSets.description: TimerTick (TICK); its payload is not read.
HttpRequest (HREQ): GET with Range bytes=0-0 and a validator no object carries; CONTEXT is an $APR whose REQUEST_ID is the source's index in the compiled table.

outputPorts.description: The source probes, one per source file.

acceptedTypeSets.description: SDS $APR list task for storage/object-s3 sign: store, endpoint, bucket, region, prefix raw/<naif>/, maxKeys 1000.
FlowNotice (FNTC): Info with the per-state counts and the changed files, Unchanged when nothing needs a refresh, Missing when the check is unconfigured or has no clock.

methods.displayName: Diff the sources against the mirror
methods.description: The probe answers (probes), the mirror listing (mirror, a $FIL) and the listing's result (mirror_result, an $APR whose non-200 STATUS says the mirror could not be read) -> the report page, an object-s3 put task that stores it (only when the mirror was listed: a page claiming an unreadable mirror is empty is never stored) and one FlowNotice.

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpResponse (HRSP) of the probes; CONTEXT carries the table index.
SDS $FIL Directory listing of raw/<naif>/ (ENTRIES: key, size, last-modified).
SDS $APR result of the list task (STATUS, ERROR_CODE).
$QRP projection page, size-prefixed: one row per source file of the body.
SDS $APR put task for storage/object-s3 sign: the report page as BODY at <report_prefix>/<naif>/<yyyy-mm-dd>.qrp.
FlowNotice (FNTC): Info with the per-state counts and the changed files, Unchanged when nothing needs a refresh, Missing when the check is unconfigured or has no clock.
